text: The tenderer must hold a valid qualification under the F-Gas Regulation, where the works include refrigeration or air-conditioning equipment.
The tenderer must have completed at least one reference project with a contract value of no less than EUR 300,000.
The tenderer must have completed at least one reference project with a contract value of no less than EUR 500,000.
The tenderer's equity ratio, as shown in its most recent financial statements, must be at least 20%.

Describe the content and scheduling of routine maintenance visits, including the annual visit calendar, the standard scope of tasks carried out at each visit, and the method used to confirm completion of each visit to the contracting authority.
Describe the response time offered for fault reports and the standby (on-call) arrangement covering evenings, weekends and public holidays.

Describe how the contractor's personnel will observe the contracting authority's access-control and site-security procedures while working on municipal premises, including school and day-care premises during operating hours.
Describe the contractor's arrangements for the periodic statutory inspection of electrical installations.
Describe how environmental matters -- waste segregation, handling of hazardous substances, and spill prevention -- are managed during the course of the works.
Include a site-specific occupational safety plan covering all properties listed in Section 2.
Describe the method and frequency proposed for inspecting the condition of the building envelope (roof, facade, windows) at each property.
State the response times offered for corrective (reactive) maintenance work, broken down by fault category.
Describe the qualification requirements the tenderer applies to personnel working on site, including any occupational cards or trade certificates required of subcontracted staff.
State the price index clause proposed for adjusting the contract price over the term of the agreement.
All prices in the tender shall be quoted in the currency stated in Section 7 of this invitation.
Confirm the tenderer's acceptance of the contractual penalty applied where the agreed service level under Section 4 is not met, as set out further in Liite B.
State the tenderer's proposed invoicing frequency and invoicing format.
Enclose curricula vitae of the key personnel proposed for delivery of the contract.
The tender shall be submitted using the Tender Form provided as Liite 1.
Prices shall be quoted in EUR per square metre per year (EUR/m2/vuosi); prices quoted on any other basis, including a monthly basis, will not be accepted for comparison.
The tender shall be submitted as a single PDF file. Password-protected files will not be opened and will be treated as not received.
All prices shall be quoted exclusive of value-added tax, in euros.
The minimum font size used throughout the tender document shall be 11pt.
Tenders shall be drafted in Finnish.

The maintenance contract for the HVAC (LVI) system shall cover, at minimum, quarterly inspection of air-handling units, annual cleaning of ductwork in kitchen and food-preparation areas, and a documented log of measurements taken at each visit.
Describe the availability of spare parts for the installed building systems and state the standard delivery time for parts not held in stock.
Describe the maintenance regime proposed for fire-protection systems, including smoke detection, fire dampers, and emergency lighting, at each property.
Confirm that lift maintenance will be carried out in accordance with the applicable regulatory inspection regime and describe the tenderer's arrangements for statutory periodic lift inspections.
A retention of the amount stated in the draft contract will be withheld from each invoice and released on the terms set out in the draft contract enclosed with these tender documents.
Include a certificate of insurance confirming the cover held by the tenderer, consistent with the tenderer's own statements elsewhere in the tender.
Include the completed Reference Form provided as Liite 2, listing the reference projects relied upon under Section 3.

In addition to the forms named above, the tender must also include a certificate of the tenderer's pension insurance payments (elakevakuutusmaksut); no separate form is provided for this purpose, a certificate from the tenderer's pension insurance provider is sufficient.
